#Importation des données
```{r}
install.packages("quantmod")
library(quantmod)

# Tickers : "TSLA", "NVDA", "BTC-USD", "MRNA", "URTH" (ETF MSCI World)
ticker <- "TSLA"
df <- getSymbols(ticker, src = "yahoo", from = "2015-01-01",
                 to = "2026-11-23", auto.assign = FALSE)

prix <- Ad(df)  # prix ajusté (splits et dividendes)
rendements <- na.omit(diff(log(prix)))  # rendements log, base des GARCH

print(tail(df))
cat("Volatilité annuelle :", round(sd(rendements) * sqrt(252) * 100, 1), "%\n")

write.zoo(df, paste0(ticker, ".csv"), sep = ",")  # sauvegarde locale

par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
plot(as.zoo(prix), log = "y", main = paste("Prix", ticker), xlab = "", ylab = "")
plot(as.zoo(rendements), main = "Rendements log", xlab = "", ylab = "")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
